title: Soft Curves with Wool Stairs
lead: Wool now comes as stairs and slabs, in all 16 colors. Use them to round off the sharp corners on balloons, sails and tents.

steps.title: Start blocky
steps.text: Build the balloon from full wool blocks, one ring on top of another. Make the middle rings the widest. Right now it looks like a lumpy box.

steps.title: Stairs on the top edges
steps.text: Swap each block on the top edge of a ring for a wool stair. Point the tall side toward the middle. The steps turn into a smooth slope.

steps.title: Slabs for the gentle parts
steps.text: Some spots are too flat for a stair. Use a wool slab there. The lid on top and the little corners are all slabs.

steps.title: Flip stairs for the bottom
steps.text: Under the balloon, use upside-down stairs. To place one, aim at the top half of a block's side. Now the bottom curves in too.

steps.title: Hang the basket
steps.text: Build a basket from Spruce Planks, with open Spruce Trapdoors for sides. Iron Chains hold it on. A campfire in the middle is the burner.

body: Wool Stairs and Wool Slabs arrived in Wilderness Bound, game version 26.50. Concrete got stairs and slabs in the same update.
The trick works on anything round. Ship sails, tent roofs, mushroom caps and clouds all look softer this way.
Think of it like this. Stairs go where the shape steps in by one block. Slabs go where it only needs a little bump.
tips: Put two stairs side by side at a corner, and they change shape to meet. That makes round corners easy.
Upside-down stairs never join right-side-up stairs. Build the top half and the bottom half as two separate jobs.
You can break wool stairs with any tool. Shears break them fastest.
challenge: Build a sail on a mast with wool stairs and slabs. Make it bulge out like it is full of wind.
